title: Roots and Powers
sourcePriority: CBE System Unit 2 HTML teaching sequence and worked examples

targets.title: Interpret roots
targets.studentCan: Identify the index and radicand and evaluate exact square, cube and fourth roots.

targets.title: Bracket and estimate roots
targets.studentCan: Bound a non-perfect root between consecutive powers and estimate its value.

targets.title: Classify rational and irrational numbers
targets.studentCan: Use fraction and decimal behaviour to classify real numbers.

targets.title: Order real numbers
targets.studentCan: Compare and place rational numbers and radicals on a number line.

targets.title: Read radical form
targets.studentCan: Identify the coefficient, index and radicand of a radical.

targets.title: Simplify to mixed form
targets.studentCan: Extract perfect powers to write a radical in simplest mixed form.

targets.title: Convert to entire form
targets.studentCan: Move a coefficient into a radical using the correct power.

targets.title: Verify equivalent radicals
targets.studentCan: Show that mixed and entire forms represent the same value within the real-number domain.

lessonMap.title: Product, quotient and zero exponent laws

targets.title: Product of powers
targets.studentCan: Multiply powers with the same base by adding exponents.

targets.title: Quotient of powers
targets.studentCan: Divide powers with the same nonzero base by subtracting exponents.

targets.title: Zero exponents
targets.studentCan: Use the zero-exponent law and state the nonzero-base restriction.

targets.title: Coefficients and variables
targets.studentCan: Simplify products and quotients containing coefficients and multiple variables.

lessonMap.title: Powers of powers, products and quotients

targets.title: Power of a power
targets.studentCan: Raise a power to a power by multiplying exponents.

targets.title: Power of a product
targets.studentCan: Distribute an exponent across every factor in a product.

targets.title: Power of a quotient
targets.studentCan: Distribute an exponent across numerator and denominator and retain restrictions.

targets.title: Combine exponent laws
targets.studentCan: Select and sequence more than one exponent law without changing the expression's value.

targets.title: Interpret a negative exponent
targets.studentCan: Explain a negative exponent as a reciprocal, not a negative value.

targets.title: Rewrite with positive exponents
targets.studentCan: Move factors across a fraction bar to express an answer using positive exponents.

targets.title: Simplify rational bases
targets.studentCan: Evaluate powers of rational bases with negative integer exponents.

targets.title: Preserve restrictions
targets.studentCan: State excluded values introduced by variable denominators and detect invalid zero-base work.

targets.title: Read a rational exponent
targets.studentCan: Interpret the denominator as a root index and the numerator as a power.

targets.title: Convert between forms
targets.studentCan: Write equivalent radical and rational-exponent forms.

targets.title: Evaluate rational exponents
targets.studentCan: Evaluate perfect-power expressions with rational exponents using a valid order.

targets.title: Respect the real-number domain
targets.studentCan: Distinguish valid odd-root cases from restricted even-root cases over the reals.

targets.title: Choose a law
targets.studentCan: Identify which exponent law applies at each step.

targets.title: Simplify multi-step expressions
targets.studentCan: Combine integer, negative and rational exponents into an equivalent simplest form.

targets.title: Evaluate exponential models
targets.studentCan: Substitute values and use order of operations in a contextual exponential model.

targets.title: Explain equivalence
targets.studentCan: Justify why each transformation preserves value and identify an invalid step.

lessonMap.title: Roots and powers transfer
source: shared textbook study guide and review

targets.title: Connect roots and exponents
targets.studentCan: Move flexibly among exact roots, radicals and rational exponents.

targets.title: Compare solution strategies
targets.studentCan: Choose an efficient valid representation and compare it with another method.

targets.title: Solve an unfamiliar problem
targets.studentCan: Apply roots and exponent laws in a changed context without copying a rehearsed example.

targets.title: Check and communicate
targets.studentCan: Verify domain, units and reasonableness and communicate the mathematical chain clearly.

mastery.helpRule: Mathematical help reduces practice credit one step with a 25 percent floor. Only a fresh, fully correct, unaided first mathematical check may establish independent mastery evidence.
mastery.freshness: Equivalent mathematics, reordered factors or cosmetic notation do not establish a fresh task. Each stage uses a genuinely changed instance.
mastery.retention: Retention requires a different task in a later session at least 48 hours after qualifying reasoning-transfer evidence.
